> This series is on top of the main linux tree [1] because it depends on some
> fuse changes in Miklos's tree that were merged into 7.2 but not yet pulled
> into Christian's vfs tree.

So I pushed out vfs-7.3.iomap based on current mainline. It'll be
rebased once -rc1 is out ofc but so you've got something to base things
one.

-- 
Christian Brauner <brauner@kernel.org>

2026-06-25.patch_summary: This patch series adds a helper to iomap that updates the uptodate bitmap whenever a folio needs to be marked uptodate, allowing external callers to mark a folio as uptodate from a non-iomap path and keep the bitmap in sync. The first patch introduces this helper, while the second patch implements its usage by fuse. This is necessary for fuse to start using large folios.
